name: Callaway Fork
about: Callaway Fork drains about 20 square miles, 89% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 870 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 480 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Callaway Fork. It includes part of New Melle. Downstream, its water passes through the Schluersburg Creek-Femme Osage Creek, Femme Osage Creek and Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
